steps.note: S2.3 states the subtract-add-undo schedule giving net change (JV+RG)x independent of the initial scratch values, which are restored, with the line-748 quote on rows 6 and 7 restoring c,a.
S2.4.1 gives central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, side cancellation of exactly the intersection-one cases, zero for intersections zero and two, and self coefficient one.
S2.4.2 gives central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2, side wires cancelling intersections zero and two, intersection one giving zero, self coefficient one.
S2.4.3 states the forward, inverse, forward invocations (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x), restoring all scratch values.
S2.6's method only says to tabulate the orthogonal residual of every edge; apart from the center 3->4 residual in S2.6.2 the plan never states the per-edge residuals or their dimensions.
The plan never treats the side edge 2->5, the relation t_X perp t_Y, or the complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2.
The plan states that center 3->4 is the only decreasing edge, losing h, telescoping at gates, sources N and sinks Wm-N giving signed Wm-2N, and the absolute sum Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich.
The plan uses an orthonormal basis of each residual (S2.8.1) but never argues that nonzero residuals over F_2 are nondegenerate and nonalternating or absorbs alternating planes.
S2.6.5 states L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2.
S2.8.1 states that orthogonal binary vectors meet evenly so weight is additive mod 4, giving q_V-q_U=sum wt(v)[v.x] over an orthonormal residual basis, negated on a decreasing edge.

S2.8.2 gives wt(v) odd, the phase i^{eps[v.x]} written as (1+i^eps)/2+(1-i^eps)/2(-1)^{v.x}, becoming aI+bX_v or its inverse; the Hadamard conjugation appears only through S2.8's frame H^{(x)m}diag(...)H^{(x)m}, not as the identity H diag(1,-1) H = X.
S2.8 and S2.8.3 give one kernel per residual basis vector and s_c in all, and S2.11.3 states the multi-column form: s_c child calls, one per residual basis vector, each on the f axes of one slot.

S2.8.4 states the X_a->Y_a repair (C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a), Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}, C=iZC^{-1}Z), but the plan never says the zero label has frame I and the full label C^{(x)m}, or that the X outputs are negated, so C^{(x)m} on the other roles is asserted, not derived.
The plan states L/N<1/2 (S2.6.5), the deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0, and s<Wm.
S2.9.1-S2.9.3 state that both deficits exceed 20*2^{-50}, that log m<20 gives m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50})>m(1-eta), and hence s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}.

S2.10.1 gives A=E_1 Pi E_2 by pivoting on the topmost nonzero row and its rightmost nonzero entry, with Pi having exactly a ones; the clearing by lower triangular operations and the repetition on active indices are only implied by 'pivoting'.

The plan works over Z/q^b (S2.10.2) but never states the choice of a fixed odd prime avoiding every denominator of the factor table, so that the identities specialize with invertible triangular factors.
S2.10.2.1 states that a lower triangular transformation updates coordinates in descending physical order by controlled shifts, at cost O(V).
S2.10.2.3 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, the interchange, then D_j<-H_i-D_j, one interchange per one of Pi and a in all, after the conjugation in S2.10.2.2.
The plan uses E, B, nu, C_0 and Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}), and states C_1=20 in S6.1.1, but never defines E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, nu, C_1=max{20,nu+3}, C_0=128mB^2, or gives nu=11.
S2.11.14 states A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E at internal nodes and A(e)<=8e at leaves, and explains why 1/W is absent; the gate count showing the per-invocation operations are below E is not given.
S2.11.15 unrolls with sx+E<=Bx and B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu to A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1}, and S2.11.16 with its line-2557 quote bounds the total below C_0 d^{C_1}.

S2.11.16 states that depth bounds both denominator and magnitude growth by Delta, that p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits are exact, and that eps*C_1<1 gives Delta=o(p); the explicit 2^{-(p+l)}Z[i], modulus 2^l induction is paraphrased, not written out.
S2.11.18 states that every row of H has absolute row sum one, so disks are preserved and truncation adds error below sqrt2 2^{-p}.

summary: P10 covers the bank-exchange network (B1-B4), the rank-saving bounds (R1-R4), most of the matrix shear (M1, M3, M4) and most of the simultaneous layer (S2-S5) fully. It omits the residual table, the side edge 2->5 and the F_2 orthonormal-basis argument of the label budget (L1, L2, L4), the complex endpoint frames (P4), the choice of a denominator-avoiding prime (M2), and the definitions of the guard constants (S1). 20 of 26 present, 0 wrong.
